name: Ferrari Testarossa
wheel_asset_status: Car-specific stock wheel shapes/animation with separate rim-only tint masks; wheel-design selection UI is not implemented.

popup_headlights.control: H/headlight toggle, independent of steering and suspension.

rim_tint.meaning: 0 preserve stock pixel; 255 tint rim; intermediate values blend tint coverage.

rim_tint.blur: Coverage-weighted average of the eight categorical spin masks.
